description: Graph-wide GitHub GraphQL error contracts. GitHub reports an error's kind in a top-level `type`, which src/graphql-transport.ts copies into `extensions.code`; document validation failures already carry `extensions.code`. Observed live on 2026-09-29: repository(owner, name) and enterprise(slug) for a missing resource returned type NOT_FOUND at the root's path; a mutation needing admin:enterprise with a token lacking it returned type INSUFFICIENT_SCOPES with no path; document validation failures returned extensions.code undefinedField (unknown field), argumentLiteralsIncompatible (wrongly typed literal), missingRequiredArguments and variableMismatch. FORBIDDEN and RATE_LIMITED are the documented types for an inaccessible resource and an exhausted GraphQL point budget. NOT_FOUND is global because every lookup by id, login, slug or name resolves it the same way.

value.description: The id, login, slug or name did not resolve to a resource the token can see.
The token can see the resource but may not perform the operation.
The token lacks an OAuth scope the selected field requires.
The GraphQL point budget for the current window is exhausted.
The document or its arguments failed GraphQL validation.
